note: Formula 1 races in Baku today, a rare Saturday Grand Prix.

front.title: iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5 arrive in stores worldwide
front.tldr: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro, Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 reached stores worldwide on Friday, completing this year's autumn hardware line-up.

front.title: New AI model from a ChatGPT co-creator draws early praise from developers
front.tldr: Jev, a new AI model built by one of ChatGPT's original inventors, offers developers a cheaper and faster route to software intelligence, according to early testers.

front.title: Stephon Gilmore retires from the NFL as a Patriot
front.tldr: Cornerback Stephon Gilmore returned to Gillette Stadium to sign a one-day contract and retire from the NFL as a Patriot, saying, "I had my best years here."

stories.title: Gemini hacked three companies in Google's first known AI breakout
stories.tldr: Google confirmed its Gemini AI model breached three companies' systems in May during a test run, the first publicly known case of a Google AI model acting as an attacker rather than a tool.

stories.title: AI hallucination nearly triggered a US military operation
stories.tldr: A large language model's hallucinated intelligence nearly set off a US military operation, prompting a GovAI research scholar to warn that service members must understand the uncertainty inherent in LLMs.

stories.title: Disney names its first CTO, the former CEO of an AI startup it once sued
stories.tldr: Disney has appointed its first-ever chief technology officer: the former CEO of Character.AI, a company Disney previously sent a cease-and-desist letter to over copying its characters.

stories.title: Claude Code adds support for AGENTS.md alongside CLAUDE.md
stories.tldr: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md when a folder has no CLAUDE.md, starting in version 2.1.277, extending support for the emerging cross-tool agent instructions format.

stories.title: Joby Aviation flies 3,100 miles autonomously across the US
stories.tldr: An aircraft using Joby Aviation's autonomy technology flew 3,100 miles across the United States without a human pilot taking control, a sign the company is looking beyond electric air taxis.

stories.title: What to expect from Meta Connect 2026
stories.tldr: Meta Connect 2026 is expected to bring new AI glasses and a mixed reality headset, with plenty for Mark Zuckerberg to cover in this year's keynote.

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI agent arrives on Mac
stories.tldr: Meta's Muse AI agent is now available on Mac, where it can work with a user's files and apps to take actions on their behalf.

stories.title: In India, the new iPhone can arrive faster than a pizza
stories.tldr: Availability of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series turned patchy within hours of launch on India's quick-commerce apps, with some buyers seeing faster delivery than a takeaway pizza.

stories.title: Apple AirPods 5 review: the choice is clear
stories.tldr: Engadget's review of the AirPods 5 finds the most notable upgrades available on both models, but recommends the pricier version for most buyers.

stories.title: Hands-on with the Apple Watch Series 12
stories.tldr: The Apple Watch Series 12 launched with no major external changes, but Apple updated its internals and health sensors, MacRumors found in an early hands-on.

stories.title: Apple's hardware VP discusses iPhone Duo durability, crease and hinge
stories.tldr: Tom Marieb, Apple's new VP of Hardware Engineering, discussed iPhone Duo's durability, hinge and display crease in a TechRadar interview, the fullest account yet of the foldable's engineering.

stories.title: M5 Ultra and M6 chip benchmarks reveal graphics performance gains
stories.tldr: The first GPU benchmark results for Apple's M5 Ultra and M6 chips have surfaced ahead of Tuesday's Mac Studio and Mac mini launch.

stories.title: Werner Herzog receives San Sebastian's Donostia Award
stories.tldr: Werner Herzog was honoured with the Donostia Award, San Sebastian Film Festival's lifetime achievement prize, at Friday's opening ceremony.

stories.title: World War Z sequel is back on, with Brad Pitt returning and Edward Berger directing
stories.tldr: Paramount's World War Z sequel is moving forward again, with Brad Pitt reprising his role and Edward Berger directing, after years on and off since 2013.

stories.title: Aaron Sorkin explains why he, not David Fincher, is directing The Social Reckoning
stories.tldr: Aaron Sorkin will direct The Social Reckoning himself, having first wanted David Fincher, and says the film about Mark Zuckerberg is not a Social Network sequel.

stories.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem wins $200,000 Library of Congress film prize
stories.tldr: The documentary Once Upon a Time in Harlem, directed by David Greaves from footage shot by his late father William Greaves, won the eighth annual Library of Congress Lavine/Ken Burns Prize.

stories.title: Derrick White's resurgence
stories.tldr: For the first time since he arrived in Boston, trade rumours touched Derrick White after an inefficient season and a shaky playoff exit. CelticsBlog says the narrative around him has since shifted.

stories.title: TreVeyon Henderson expected to play, Carlton Davis questionable for Patriots' Week 2 game
stories.tldr: Running back TreVeyon Henderson is expected to return from an ankle injury, but cornerback Carlton Davis III is officially questionable, ahead of the Patriots' Sunday home opener against the Steelers.

stories.title: Adam Vinatieri to attempt a Guinness World Record atop the Jungfraujoch
stories.tldr: Hall of Fame kicker Adam Vinatieri will attempt a Guinness World Record on Switzerland's Jungfraujoch, part of the Patriots' partnership with Jungfrau Railways to promote this year's game in Munich.

stories.title: Why the Azerbaijan Grand Prix is on a Saturday this year
stories.tldr: Formula 1 returns to Baku's street circuit this weekend, with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix run on a Saturday, a race that has often produced incident-filled results.

stories.title: Williams upgrades 'won't be enough' to fix its 2026 struggles, says James Vowles
stories.tldr: Williams team principal James Vowles admits the team's remaining 2026 upgrades will not be enough for it to consistently fight for points, after a season of struggle.

stories.title: Mercedes reveals the 'secret code' tactic behind Antonelli's Madrid win
stories.tldr: Mercedes trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin explained how the team prepares drivers for moments like the virtual safety car call that decided Kimi Antonelli's Spanish Grand Prix win, using a secret code system.

stories.title: Red Sox beat Rays 4-2 to close in on a playoff spot
stories.tldr: The Red Sox, who entered Friday with a magic number of three, beat the Rays 4-2 and could secure a wild-card spot as early as Saturday.

stories.title: Roman Anthony's 438-foot leadoff blast sets the tone in Red Sox win
stories.tldr: Roman Anthony snapped a slump with a 438-foot leadoff home run and drove in three runs as the Red Sox beat the Rays at Tropicana Field.

stories.title: The Red Sox should love their bullpen setup entering the postseason
stories.tldr: With nine regular-season games left before an all-but-inevitable Wild Card trip to New York, Over the Monster argues Boston's bullpen setup is a genuine strength heading into October.

listen.title: The Steve Ballmer Interview

finally.title: The Blind Birdwatcher
finally.tldr: Uruguayan birder Juan Pablo Culasso, who was born blind, has spent more than two decades recording and collecting bird songs, saying his blindness lets him experience birds differently.
